# Spinner
Atlas Spinner v1 — an indeterminate loading indicator. 2 variants × 4 sizes (8 total). default is the Lucide loader-circle arc; custom is the Lucide loader (eight ticks). Sizes xs 16 · sm 20 · md 24 · lg 32 map to icon/size/*, stroke to icon/stroke/*. Colour is foreground and inherits the surrounding text colour in code.

When to use: a short, indeterminate wait (a button submitting, a section or toast loading) where the duration or progress is unknown. Pair with a visible or screen-reader label.
When not to use: for a known percentage (use Progress) or for content-shaped placeholders while a page loads (use Skeleton).

Motion: one full clockwise turn every duration/spin (1000ms) with easing/linear, looping. Under prefers-reduced-motion the rotation stops and the icon is shown static.

Accessibility: role=status with an accessible label (default "Loading"); the icon itself is aria-hidden. No hover, focus, active or disabled state.
